records.text: A USA TODAY article published shortly after Charlie Kirk's assassination said Erika Kirk had worked as a New York City real-estate agent for The Corcoran Group.
records.speaker: TikTok Creator (Ep ti5Fxrvegno; name unverified)

appearances.snippet: Now this article that was posted shortly after Charlie Kirk's assassination by USA Today states that Erika Kirk worked as a real estate agent in New York City for the Corcoran Group.

verification.notes: Later reporting specifically identifies the September 2025 USA TODAY article and says it reported that Erika Kirk worked with the Corcoran Group. records.text: The TikTok creator said public accounts identify Pamela Liebman as president and CEO of The Corcoran Group since 2000.
records.speaker: TikTok Creator (Ep ti5Fxrvegno; name unverified)

appearances.snippet: So if we're to believe the story that she works as a real estate agent for the Corcoran Group, then her boss would be Pamela Liebman because Pamela (Pamela Liebman) has been the president and CEO of the Corcoran Group since... Since 2000, at least that's what the public has been told.

verification.notes: Corcoran's own corporate history says Pamela Liebman became CEO in 2000 and continues to identify her as president and CEO. This directly supports the public-account claim.

records.text: An Epstein document's name-search entry for Lynn Forester, also known as Lady de Rothschild, listed her work affiliation as president of The Corcoran Group.
records.speaker: TikTok Creator (Ep ti5Fxrvegno; name unverified)

appearances.snippet: Now, in this Epstein document that's doing an official name search, an alias for Lynn Forester, a.k.a. Lady de Rothschild, it states that under her work affiliations she is the Corcoran Group, Inc. president. And it even shows her email which is redacted.

verification.notes: The DOJ-released CLEAR background report identified as EFTA01654681 lists Corcoran Group among Lynn Forester's work affiliations, and analysis of the exact report records the Corcoran Group Inc. president entry. This verifies what the document lists, not that Forester actually held that office; Corcoran's own history identifies Pamela Liebman as CEO from 2000.
